page_title: FUL 0-4 MCI | Fulham v Manchester City 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' 0 - 4 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Bernd Leno no chance!
90+6' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+5' It is too late to protest. Issa Diop (Fulham) knew very well what he was doing and subsequently receives a second yellow card, ending the match for him.
90+5' Issa Diop (Fulham) brings an opponent down and Anthony Taylor interrupts the game. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Manchester City.
90+2' A long pass finds Rodri (Manchester City) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
89' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
87' The game is interrupted now, Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
82' The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester City.
82' Here comes a substitution. Phil Foden is given a rest as he is replaced by Oscar Bobb (Manchester City).
82' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Mateo Kovacic will be replaced by Rico Lewis (Manchester City).
82' That's the end of the game for Erling Haaland, who is replaced by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City).

81' Bernd Leno makes a brilliant save! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the left side of the goal but is saved by the keeper! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Issa Diop (Fulham) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' The ball is cleared after Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
75' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Kevin De Bruyne and he is replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
74' Substitution. Andreas Pereira did his best and is replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
74' No offside! Referee Anthony Taylor points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Manchester City players celebrate.
73' The Manchester City players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
71' 0 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Bernardo Silva plays it into the box, and Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
71' Phil Foden (Manchester City) works the corner short.
71' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and signals a foul after Issa Diop (Fulham) brought his opponent down.
68' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
67' Substitution. Armando Broja (Fulham) has come on for Rodrigo Muniz.
65' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) plays a terrific long ball forward to Alex Iwobi, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
61' What a big chance! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.

59' 0 - 2 Goal! Phil Foden (Manchester City) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Bernd Leno is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 0:2.
58' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bernd Leno intercepts the ball.

58' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) after he collected a pass and unleashed his low drive. The ball was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
57' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom left corner. His effort is blocked by Ederson with a brilliant diving save!
56' Issa Diop (Fulham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.

53' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Bernd Leno is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

52' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
51' Manchester City are seeing far more of the ball now.
47' Issa Diop (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' Half-time substitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) will not participate anymore and Tom Cairney is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Silva probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Willian (Fulham). He is replaced by Adama Traore.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' An attempted cross from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is cleared.
45' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alex Iwobi (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
44' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) squandered a big chance from inside the box, firing his volley narrowly over the bar. What a waste.
44' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).
43' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
42' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but Bernd Leno comes off his line to gather the ball.
40' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
39' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
38' A first-time shot by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. Manchester City force their opponents to concede a corner.
37' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
35' Phil Foden (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
33' Rodri (Manchester City) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
33' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
28' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
27' 0:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.

25' A sweet pass finds Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Bernd Leno is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
22' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) is being substituted because of an injury. Pep Guardiola sends Kyle Walker on the pitch.
21' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
19' Willian (Fulham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
16' Willian (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
15' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot over the bar.

13' 0 - 1 Goal! Kevin De Bruyne shows great vision to find Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
9' A spell of possession for Fulham in an attempt to control the game.
6' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is penalised for holding. Anthony Taylor signals a set piece.
3' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
2' The corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is intercepted by the defence.
2' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Fulham get a corner.
